title: private-deployment-orion-weekly-sync-2026-08-17
content:
Weekly sync prep + action items for Orion private deployment (VPC/on-prem)

Meeting: Orion weekly sync (prep notes)
Date: 2026-08-17
Owner: Ethan Brooks
Attendees (expected): Samira (SE), Luca (SRE), Grace (Security), John R. (Orion infra), Priya (Solutions lead)

Goals for this week
- Validate network egress and NAT rules for model pull during air-gapped install
- Finalize KMS/HSM integration checklist and certs
- Confirm DB connectivity path and performance baseline (replica lag concerns)
- Agree cutover window for staging->prod and rollback plan

Agenda (20-30m)
1) Quick status round (3m)
2) Network & packaging blockers (7m)
   - DNAT/firewall rules, proxy config, image registry access
3) Security & compliance items (5m)
   - KMS integration, key rotation, audit logs
4) SRE / infra readiness (5m)
   - Monitoring alerts, autoscale policy, chaos tests schedule
5) Action items & owners (3-5m)

Notes / current status (updates since last sync)
- Network: Orion infra applied basic firewall rules but still blocking TCP 443 to our model registry; John said their infra team schedules change window on Thu 8/19. We need registry allowlist + signed image fallback.
- Packaging: Air-gapped installer currently fails on image signature verification for a small number of images (quantized kernels). Grace suspects missing cosign key in the offline bundle.
- KMS / keys: KMS handshake worked in lab, but Orion requires HSM-backed key material and attestation flow—Grace is coordinating with Orion security. Confluence page updated with HSM vendor contact.
- DB: Observed 2s median p99 query on staging under 20% traffic; under load test, replica lag spikes to ~6s. Luca proposed temporary increase in connection pool + read replica tuning.
- Monitoring: Alert runbook incomplete for disk pressure on model cache nodes. Need final runbook before cutover.

Blockers (high priority)
- OR-101 (network): Model registry not reachable from Orion env (blocked by firewall rules). Impact: prevents image pull during install. Owner: John Reyes / Orion infra. Target: 2026-08-19 change window.
- OR-102 (packaging): Missing cosign key in offline installer -> image signature verification failure. Owner: Grace Li. Target: 2026-08-18 to produce signed offline bundle.
- OR-103 (kms): HSM attestation flow lacking formal acceptance tests. Owner: Priya Natarajan + Orion security. Target: 2026-08-21 for test plan.
- OR-104 (db): Replica lag under load. Owner: Luca Moretti. Target: 2026-08-20 for tuning + load run.

Action items (owner / due / notes)
- John R: Open firewall allowlist for registry (allow registry.redwood-inference.com) + confirm change window. Due 2026-08-19.
- Grace: Build & validate signed offline bundle with cosign key; attach bundle to Confluence and share checksum. Due 2026-08-18.
- Priya + Orion Sec: Draft HSM attestation test cases and acceptance criteria; share for review. Due 2026-08-21.
- Luca: Run DB replica tuning + a 30m load test to verify replica lag <=2s; post results. Due 2026-08-20.
- Ethan: Prepare runbook for model-cache disk pressure alerts (include thresholds, mitigations, runbook steps). Due 2026-08-19.
- Samira: Smoke test upgrade path for a non-prod cluster using the signed bundle; note any steps that require manual intervention. Due 2026-08-20.

Open questions / notes-to-self
- If registry allowlist slips beyond 8/19, we need to plan for pre-pulled images delivered on a secure USB as contingency (logistics + chain-of-custody). Price/contract needs check with sales.
- Confirm whether Orion's HSM supports PKCS#11 or requires custom adapter; this affects our client shim (PR queued: github PR-89).
- Need to finalize SLA language about maintenance windows for on-prem customers (legal follow-up).

Prep checklist to run in meeting
- Quick check against blockers list and confirm owners/dates
- Confirm whether Orion can do the 8/19 change window; if not, propose 8/26 fallback
- Ask Orion to provide sysadmin contact for image allowlist config (get direct slack/email)

Follow-ups after meeting (my immediate next steps)
- Triage OR-102 locally to reproduce signature failure, create minimal repro steps for Grace
- Draft contingency note for sales/legal re: pre-pulled image process and costs
- Update Confluence with latest runbook link and mark sections that are draft

Notes: keep meeting tight, focus on unblockers only. If time permits, surface monitoring dashboard screenshots (staging) and p99 latency numbers.

-- Ethan
